text: oh sorry there is a step missing. after detach i selected all and moved it along X to pull it away from the car, and that is what made it concave
resolution: Fixed the missing-move root cause: detach now splits logical vertex identity at the new part boundary so rigid X translation cannot falsely buckle shared seam faces; Detach also installs scope and journal metadata synchronously so Split/Undo restores the correct rows.
